_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the workshop. Edit here and every page, the poster, the QR codes, the calendar files, the JSON-LD and the social cards update on the next build. Prose in i18n.json, src/_data/pagecopy/*.json, copy.json, faq.json and schedule.json never repeats the email, date, times or Zoom numbers: it uses tokens such as {email}, {date}, {time}, {startsAlso}, {zoomId} and {passcode}, which the build fills in from here. The exceptions are description and metaDescription, which spell the time out in plain text; update them by hand if the time ever changes. Field notes are in docs/EDITING.md.
name: The Incredible Tapestry
title: The Incredible Tapestry: Weaving the Steps, Traditions & Concepts Together
tagline: Weaving the Steps, Traditions & Concepts into One Fellowship
subtitle: How the Steps, Traditions and Concepts weave this incredible tapestry
description: A free, 1-day online A.A. workshop on Saturday, December 12, 2026, 11 AM – 7 PM ET (8 AM PT · 9 AM MT · 10 AM CT): a series of presentations on how the Steps, Traditions and Concepts weave this incredible tapestry, with plenty of time for sharing and asking questions. On Zoom, with Spanish and ASL interpretation. No pre-registration is required.

event.name: The Incredible Tapestry Workshop
event.cost: Free. There will be some expenses for the Spanish and ASL interpretation, and contributions are welcome to help cover them.
event.audience: Open to all A.A. members, anyone who thinks they might have a problem with alcohol, and trusted servants at every level. Newcomers warmly welcome.
event.audienceEs: Abierto a todos los miembros de A.A., a cualquier persona que piense que puede tener un problema con el alcohol y a los servidores de confianza de todos los niveles. Los recién llegados son muy bienvenidos.

interpretation.label: Spanish interpretation
interpretation.note: Choose the Spanish channel from the Interpretation (globe) button in Zoom. On a phone or tablet, it is under More, then Language Interpretation.
interpretation.noteEs: En Zoom, el canal en español se elige con el botón Interpretación (Interpretation, el globo terráqueo). En el teléfono o la tableta, está en Más (More) y luego en Interpretación de idiomas (Language Interpretation).

interpretation.label: ASL interpretation
interpretation.labelEs: Interpretación en ASL (lengua de señas americana)
interpretation.note: Choose ASL from the Interpretation (globe) button to open Zoom's sign language view if it is offered, or pin the interpreter's video.
interpretation.noteEs: Desde el botón Interpretación (Interpretation, el globo terráqueo) se puede elegir ASL para abrir la vista de lengua de señas de Zoom, si está disponible, o bien fijar (Pin) el video del intérprete.

zoom._readme: Also editable from GitHub → Actions → 'Update Zoom info' without touching this file. dialIn: the "Dial by your location" phone numbers from the host’s Zoom invitation, only if telephone audio is on for the meeting; leave [] to hide the Dial in row (then /join/ step 1 tells members to email the committee about joining by telephone).

legacies.blurbEs: Los Pasos son la manera en que cada alcohólico se recupera: un programa espiritual de acción, un día a la vez.

legacies.name: Unity
legacies.source: Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions and A.A. Comes of Age

legacies.blurbEs: Las Tradiciones son la manera en que el grupo se mantiene sano: las lecciones, aprendidas con esfuerzo, que nos mantienen unidos para que la mano de A.A. siempre esté ahí.

legacies.name: Service
legacies.body: The Twelve Concepts for World Service

legacies.blurbEs: Los Conceptos son la manera en que la Comunidad en su conjunto se mantiene sana: los principios que permiten que nuestra estructura de servicio lleve el mensaje a todo el mundo.

contact._readme: email is the questions address printed on the official flyer. Every page PRINTS it once, in the questions band at the top of the footer (and the printable poster prints it); everywhere else (FAQ answers, the contributions note, the accessibility note) it is a link labelled 'Email the planning committee' / 'Escribir al comité organizador' (i18n contact.linkText; in Markdown prose [email the planning committee](mailto:{email})); never write a bare {email} in prose, which would print it a second time. The calendar entry (DESCRIPTION) and the JSON-LD carry it too. Leave it empty only to hide all of them. icsOrganizer: true would also write it as the .ics ORGANIZER; it is off because Outlook then treats the entry as a meeting request. formUrl: optional link to a contact form (leave empty). committee is the © line in the footer and the feed's author; committeeEs is the same name for the Spanish pages' © line (and the Spanish .ics ORGANIZER).
contact.committee: The Incredible Tapestry Workshop Planning Committee
contact.committeeEs: Comité organizador del taller The Incredible Tapestry

flyer._readme: The committee's official flyer (English; image-only PDF), published from brand/flyer/. To replace it, drop new files there with the same names and update width/height (of the -1000 image), pdfSize/jpgSize (the real file sizes, shown next to the download buttons) and the three zoom* fields. zoomMeetingId, zoomPasscode and zoomJoinUrl are the Zoom details the flyer image prints: when any of them differs from event.zoom, pages warn above the flyer that its Zoom details are out of date.

updates._readme: News for the updates feed (/feed.xml, in English; built in eleventy.config.js and linked from every page's footer). Feed readers show each new item to their subscribers, so add one only for real news (the full program is posted, the Zoom details change…), newest FIRST. Each item: id (permanent: never change it once published; for a new item use tag:aatapestry.org,<date>:<a-short-slug>), date (YYYY-MM-DD), title (plain text), link (the page the news is about) and body (simple Markdown). Write the email, date, times and Zoom numbers in the body only as tokens ({email}, {date}, {time}, {startsAlso}, {zoomId}, {passcode}…), and link the email as [email the planning committee](mailto:{email}). Site links such as (/join/) are made absolute in the feed.

items.title: A new look for the workshop website
items.body: The website has a new look, with one clear place for each thing: [How to join](/join/) has the Zoom details, Spanish and ASL interpretation and tips for the day; the [Program](/program/) shows the hours in your time zone, and the full program will be posted there; and the [flyer](/flyer/) is ready to print or pass along. The workshop runs {time} ({startsAlso}). It is free, and no pre-registration is required.

items.title: The official flyer is out, and the Zoom details are set
items.body: The official flyer is here: [see it, print it or pass it along](/flyer/). The Zoom details are set and are on the [How to join](/join/) page; no pre-registration is required. The workshop runs {time} ({startsAlso}). It is free, and contributions to help cover the Spanish and ASL interpretation are welcome. For questions, please [email the planning committee](mailto:{email}).
